01.label: The full dashboard after transfer
01.try: Open the complete 20-chart Individual Data dashboard with an explicit reporting window.
01.expected: All 20 charts render or report a legitimate empty result. SQL, calculated columns, layout and filter bindings match the versioned package.
01.videoIntro: The April dashboard is imported into a separate instance with different chart IDs. This walkthrough shows the complete dashboard after the import checks pass.
01.videoOutro: The full dashboard is preserved. On 6.1.0, the deployment helper repairs cached filter references; the snapshot remaps those references natively.

02.label: Month, Quarter and Year labels
02.try: Change Time Unit while keeping the reporting dates fixed.
02.expected: Date axes and hover details use Jan 2025, Q1 2025 and 2025. Dates remain chronologically ordered.
02.videoIntro: Use the same reporting window with three grouping choices. The CSiM formatter follows the selected unit on the trend charts and the lower date axes.
02.videoOutro: The formatter changes presentation without converting dates into text. All eleven date axes are checked when they contain data.

03.label: Missing periods and selected dates
03.try: Inspect hospital 91, then narrow the window to February–March and group by Quarter.
03.expected: February is missing, March is a valid zero, and February–March has 10 submissions without January.
03.videoIntro: Known test records make these differences visible: no February submissions, a valid zero rate in March, and a partial-quarter window.
03.videoOutro: Calendar rows retain missing months. The date window filters observations before grouping, and an empty selection can return to a populated result on the same page.

04.label: Change and clear dashboard filters
04.try: Set Time Period and Time Unit in either order, then clear and reselect.
04.expected: Equivalent selections return equivalent results. The dashboard recovers without a page reload.
04.videoIntro: Time Period selects observations; Time Unit groups them. This workflow checks both selection orders and recovery after Clear all.
04.videoOutro: Both orders produce the same results. Reselecting the filters restores the charts on the same page. Historical intermittent authoring and navigation reports remain separate.

05.label: Time Unit choices
05.try: Inspect the saved Time Unit menus for this installation.
05.expected: Main: Month/Quarter/Year is an instance-wide workaround. Snapshot: CSiM and hourly reporting save independent menus.
05.videoIntro: The released build restricts choices across the whole instance. The pinned development snapshot supports independent saved choices for each dashboard.
05.videoOutro: The distinction is a Superset version capability. The main build retains the global workaround; the snapshot demonstrates the native per-dashboard feature.

06.label: Two series across a year boundary
06.try: Compare hospitals 91 and 92 in Month, Quarter and Year views.
06.expected: Both series remain ordered across 2025–2026, with readable date labels.
06.videoIntro: Text dates can sort incorrectly when a chart compares multiple series. These charts retain real dates and format the labels separately.
06.videoOutro: The two series remain chronological. The released renderer also includes an opt-in correction that keeps the first date label visible.
